resources.string: Introductory questions cover selected excerpts, not the entire document or your overall ability. Sources are traceable, not independently verified.
Answer from your current understanding. Not sure is welcome. Tapping an answer takes you to the next question. This is preparation for a conversation, not a scored practice game.
We will explain uncertain concepts first. A correct answer is evidence for this item only, not proof of mastery. Not sure stays separate from an incorrect answer.
This explainer follows a script written ahead of time. Your questions are saved, but it cannot answer them yet.
AI explanations can be wrong. Open the original passage to check important claims.
All introductory concepts are covered. You can keep asking or return to your shelf.
The quote only shows where this comes from. It doesn\'t prove the explanation is right.
Could not complete this step (%1$s). Saved records are retained. Retry or reload to reconcile with the server.
Offline: showing saved answers and conversation. Reconnect for new server replies.
This preset has no dedicated diagnostic yet. Its original passages are below. Pick a course that has an explanation, or import a document for the tutor flow.
This session has reached its 40-turn limit. Existing conversation is retained.

Confirm to send this document to the server below. It reads the text and prepares a few starting questions. This is a practice server with no real AI, so the questions are simple stand-ins. A server set up differently may use a real AI.
No server configured in this build. The offline fixed example is available.
The document has been uploaded and its text extracted.
Unable to continue (%1$s). Check the server connection and file. Successful uploads are reused during this import.
Cancel stops this screen from accepting late results. A document already received by the server is retained; cancellation is not deletion.
Preview with a separate self-authored example. It is not generated from the selected file.
Practice is generated separately. It does not reuse your diagnostic as a score.
Written for this course ahead of time. Nothing is uploaded and no AI is running; your answers here stay on this device.
A few foundation questions, then an explanation that starts where you are. Pre-written for this course; no upload, no AI.
What do you want to get out of this reading?
Pick anything that matters to you. It only changes the order we go through things in; nothing is skipped.
Saved on this device. Offline it cannot change the explanation; it can only steer an AI explainer when you are online.
Your note: “%1$s” (saved on this device; this explainer cannot read it)
Pinch to zoom, double-tap to reset
The original file isn\'t stored on this phone; this is its text. Have the PDF? Attach it to see the real pages.
Attach your copy of the original PDF to see the real page

This isn\'t the exact file this course was measured on (its fingerprint doesn\'t match), so nothing can be marked on it. Showing the extracted text. Expected: %1$s, %2$s; this file is %3$s. If that exact download is still refused, the course\'s page layout needs re-measuring.
That file is over 20 MB. Showing the extracted text.
That file isn\'t a PDF. Showing the extracted text.
That file couldn\'t be read or kept. Showing the extracted text.
PDF attached. This passage has no position on its page, so its text is shown here.
This file couldn\'t be opened as a PDF. Please choose another PDF.
This PDF is over 20 MB. Please choose a smaller one, or split it into parts.
This PDF is locked with a password. Remove the password, then choose it again.
This PDF is made of pictures, so there is no text to read. Please choose a PDF where you can select the text.
